valor: Con noticiarios, el documental combina las denuncias contra Kurt Waldheim, antiguo soldado del aparato militar nazi y exsecretario general de las Naciones Unidas, con pruebas de su convicción de poder llevar a Austria a una nueva era de «gloria» y del apoyo popular que recibió. Un caso que resuena con patrones históricos que parecen repetirse.

antes.ficci-65: Ruth Beckermann documenta el escándalo político que estalló en Austria cuando se reveló el pasado nazi de Kurt Waldheim durante su campaña presidencial de 1986.

valor: Drawing on newsreels, the documentary combines the accusations against Kurt Waldheim, a former soldier in the Nazi military apparatus and ex-UN Secretary-General, with evidence of his conviction that he could lead Austria into a new era of “glory” and of his popular support. A case echoing historical patterns that seem to repeat themselves.

antes.ficci-65: Ruth Beckermann documents the political scandal that erupted in Austria when Kurt Waldheim's Nazi past was revealed during his 1986 presidential campaign.
